expectations.text: Identifies QC 1000 as the PCAOB quality control standard taking effect December 15, 2026
expectations.evidence: "QC 1000, 'A Firm's System of Quality Control,' was adopted by the PCAOB... The PCAOB extended it by one year, to December 15, 2026."

expectations.text: Describes the September 9, 2026 amendments: rescinded the design-only requirement and the External QC Function requirement, and let firms choose their annual evaluation date
expectations.evidence: The September 9, 2026 amendments are never mentioned; the response only references the original May 2024 adoption and conforming amendments adopted at that time.

expectations.text: States the SEC approved the amendments on November 2, 2026 with the effective date unchanged
expectations.evidence: No mention of a November 2, 2026 SEC approval; the response only says the SEC approved the original standard "later that year" (2024) and tells the user to verify dates on the PCAOB website.

expectations.text: Explains it governs audit firms' quality control systems, so it affects the auditor rather than imposing direct issuer obligations
expectations.evidence: "QC 1000 is a firm-level PCAOB standard for audit firms. It is not a requirement on your company... It does not create new deliverables for the issuer."

expectations.text: Advises discussing with the auditor how QC 1000 affects the 2026 year-end audit
expectations.evidence: "Ask your audit partner how the firm is implementing QC 1000 and whether any timing or request changes are planned for the year-end audit."
